name: Aranka Pieters
title: Senior executive coach and communication trainer
bio_short: Senior executive coach (ICF PCC) and communication trainer with more than 15 years' experience. Formerly led customer services and sales at a well-known international health insurance fund. Specialises in executive presence and interpersonal communication.
bio: Aranka is a senior executive coach and communication trainer with more than 15 years' experience across corporate leadership, coaching and training. An ICF Professional Certified Coach, she works with senior leaders, teams and professionals, and has designed and delivered corporate programmes in leadership, communication, coaching skills, collaboration and assertiveness. Aranka spent more than 11 years at a well-known international health insurance fund, rising from client adviser to leading its customer services and sales division, with responsibility for around 120 staff across 50 branches, direct management of eight team leaders and a portfolio of change and digitalisation projects. She has run her own coaching and training practice since 2020, has lectured in management and communication at Karel de Grote University of Applied Sciences in Antwerp and holds a sociology degree from the University of Antwerp alongside Insights and NLP qualifications. At ISOC, Aranka delivers executive coaching and programmes in executive presence and interpersonal communication. Her route from front-line adviser to running a 120-person sales and service operation means she coaches executives on performance, presence and team dynamics she has managed first hand. Aranka is based in Belgium and trains in English and Dutch.
